spending_entity: Agence Nationale des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (ANSIE)
programme: Agence Nationale des Systèmes d'Information de l'État (ANSIE)
purpose: The whole operating and investment budget of the state's information-systems agency, which runs government networks, the data centre and shared platforms such as the X-Road exchange layer.
scope_basis: Single-mandate body: ANSIE was created by law 100/AN/15 to build and run the state's information systems, so its whole budget is a digital line (the spec's single-mandate carve-out). It is a public administrative establishment under the Presidency, which proposes the arrêté.
amount_scale: full Djibouti francs as printed (FDJ); the article prints no scale factor
doc_locator: Arrêté n° 2025-064/PRE (signed 23 Mar 2025, eJO 16 Jun 2025), article 1, En charges
notes: Cross-foot: products and charges equal at 556,753,165, the only split printed; the Council of Ministers record of 30 Dec 2025 cites the 2025 budget as 556.7 million, which agrees. Stage: board deliberation of 10 Nov 2024, Council of Ministers 14 Jan 2025, executory arrêté, so appropriated; it was signed in March, three months into the year it governs. Up 23.2% on 2024. Funding source unstated, as FY2024. No 2025 accounts are published yet. HTML artefact md5-matched.

spending_entity: Institut de la Statistique de Djibouti (INSTAD)
programme: Institut de la Statistique de Djibouti (INSTAD)
purpose: The whole budget of the national statistics institute, which produces official statistics (national accounts, the census, household surveys) and coordinates the national statistical system.
scope_basis: Single-mandate body: INSTAD's statutory remit (law 26/AN/18 as amended by 108/AN/20, and law 124 of 2011 on statistical activity) is official statistics and nothing else, which falls within data governance; held whole as The Gambia's GBOS and Morocco's statistics office are. It is a public administrative establishment under the finance ministry, which proposes the arrêté.
amount_scale: full Djibouti francs as printed (FDJ); the article prints no scale factor
doc_locator: Arrêté n° 2025-026/PR/MEFI (signed 22 Jan 2025, eJO 20 Feb 2025), article 1, Charges d'exploitation
notes: Cross-foot: products (printed as subsidies) equal operating charges at 456,943,040. Stage: board adoption 12 Nov 2024, Council of Ministers 7 Jan 2025, executory arrêté, so appropriated. Funding source unstated: the products are labelled subsidies but the grantor is not named, and INSTAD also runs donor-funded surveys. Every charge is printed as operating; no investment line.
